headline: Follow Airthings readings from sensor to Home Assistant
intro: Connect Airthings sensors to Home Assistant with a valid Airthings Dashboard login and API credentials. An Airthings SmartLink hub provides live updates; without one, the Airthings mobile app syncs data over Bluetooth and uploads it to the cloud.
highlights: Create an API connection in the Airthings Dashboard and use its generated ID and Secret to activate the integration
Use an Airthings SmartLink hub for live sensor updates, or sync through the Airthings mobile app over Bluetooth and the cloud
Allow time for a new radon sensor to appear when the Airthings API initially reports its value as unknown

flow.title: From Airthings API credentials to sensor readings
stages: Request and save an API Client in Airthings Dashboard to generate an ID and Secret
Add Airthings from Settings → Devices & services and enter the credentials
Wait for a new radon sensor to appear if its value is initially unknown
